findings.title: OS Command Injection
findings.trigger: If the process name contains special shell characters like `;` or `&`, it could be used to inject and execute arbitrary commands.
findings.assumptions: The process name might be controlled by an attacker if the hook is set on a malicious application.

findings.title: Buffer Overflow
findings.trigger: If the window title is longer than MAX_PATH characters, it could overflow the processName buffer.
findings.assumptions: The window title might be controlled by an attacker if the hook is set on a malicious application.

findings.title: Cross-Site Scripting (XSS)

findings.assumptions: The process name might be controlled by an attacker if the hook is set on a malicious application.
